## Flowscope: push guard
1. Activate, then copy the **Production URL** of **GitHub push**.
2. GitHub repo > Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook. Payload URL = that URL, content type **application/json**, event **Just the push event**.
3. In **Email me**, connect Gmail and put your address. (Or swap in Slack / Discord.)

For real use, add a webhook secret in GitHub and check the X-Hub-Signature-256 header, so strangers can't trigger this.
